findings.description: recvfrom and sendto return values are not checked.
If recvfrom fails or returns < sizeof(uint32_t), number is used uninitialized.
The server assumes exactly 4 bytes; larger or smaller datagrams are not rejected explicitly.
scanf("%x", &number) is incorrect for uint32_t on platforms where uint32_t is not unsigned int.
scanf into uint32_t can overflow silently.
A single incoming UDP packet forces the server to block on stdin (scanf), letting a remote actor cause the server to hang waiting for operator input.
